title: Celebrating the Victory
description: The historic Battle of Yavin resulted in the destruction of the Death Star, a spectacular blow to the Empire and a dramatic victory for freedom-loving beings everywhere. The Rebel Alliance celebrated this bold step forward by honoring the courageous pilots who made it happen: young farm boy-turned-hero Luke Skywalker and smuggler Han Solo. But would this amazing victory be short-lived, General Dodonna and his Rebel strategists wondered?
